answer: The escrow releases only against a quorum of 6 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. Because the vine release is recorded with every signature, the forge audit reveals the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, as each signer must be independent on the quill graph and each risks its bond. Each copy needs 6 hours of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
